 Ashna Gaur Thu, November 19, 2026 at 8:09 PM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Photo Credit: Not Gonna Lie with Kylie Kelce via YouTube Kylie Kelce did not hold back after a fan asked an intimate question about her relationship with husband Jason Kelce . The podcast host expressed frustration over the unexpected inquiry and questioned why listeners felt comfortable asking about her private life.
 The 34-year-old addressed the submission during the November 19 episode of her podcast, Not Gonna Lie. The exchange took place during a fan-interaction segment, where Kylie responded to questions from her audience.
 Kylie Kelce was caught off guard by a personal question about Jason
 During the podcast's "Ask Me Some Things" segment, Kylie read a submission about her marriage to the retired NFL player. The listener referenced Jason's physical strength and family life before asking how the couple maintained excitement in their bedroom.
 "Jason is strong, muscular, with football and kids," the message read. "How would do you [sic] spice up the bedroom?"
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Kylie reacted with an audible groan before expressing her disbelief. "Yes, that audible groan is the appropriate response," she said. "What the actual f—?"
 The mother of four explained that such submissions prompted her to rename the segment from "Ask Me Anything" to "Ask Me Some Things." She criticized the inappropriate questions that regularly appeared in her inbox.
 The podcaster, who married Jason in 2018, had previously confronted followers over their comments about her husband. Last year, she addressed social media users who posted drooling emojis under his suggestive photographs.
 "We've got some people in these comments; they are f—— around," she said during an earlier podcast episode. "Imma need you to sit down, put your tongues back in your mouth and be respectful."
 Advertisement Advertisement However, Kylie also acknowledged her husband's appeal and admitted that she understood the reactions. She reminded listeners that Jason was the father of her children and emphasized their marriage.
 According to PEOPLE , Her willingness to confront online criticism extended beyond questions about their relationship. In September, Kylie responded to a commenter who judged her parenting because of the condition of her minivan.
 The following month, she also addressed questions about her family's property arrangements. After commenters criticized her ownership of surrounding houses, Kylie explained that the decision helped protect her family's safety , privacy, and security.
